diagram:
flowchart TD
  SIG_IN["📥 Receive agent_signal"] --> CHECK_CASH["💰 Check Cash Balance"]
  CHECK_CASH --> SIZE_POS["📐 Size Position\npositionSizePct% of NAV"]
  SIZE_POS --> FILL["✅ Fill at Market Price"]
  FILL --> SET_EXITS["🎯 Set price_target + stop_loss"]
  SET_EXITS --> LOG["💾 Write paper_positions"]

SIG_IN.label: Receive agent_signal
SIG_IN.description: Reads qualifying signals from agent_signals — direction=long, score >= scoreThreshold, not already held.
SIG_IN.addReason: Entry point — signals from ResearchAgent or DeepSeek.

CHECK_CASH.label: Check Cash Balance
CHECK_CASH.description: Reads paper_portfolio.cash_balance. Skips trade if insufficient cash.

SIZE_POS.label: Size Position
SIZE_POS.description: Position value = cash_balance × (position_size_pct / 100). Conservative 7%, Balanced 10%, Aggressive 15%.
SIZE_POS.addReason: Equal-dollar sizing per trade. Risk profile controls concentration.
SIZE_POS.changeReason: Changed from hardcoded 10% to position_size_pct from risk profile

FILL.label: Fill at Market Price
FILL.description: Current price from Robinhood quote or Polygon. Records fill_price, qty.

SET_EXITS.label: Set price_target + stop_loss
SET_EXITS.description: price_target = signal.price_target ?? fill × (1+target_pct/100). stop_loss = fill × (1-stop_loss_pct/100). highest_price = fill.
SET_EXITS.addReason: Previously no exit criteria except 7-day time limit. Now exits by target or stop with trailing.

LOG.label: Write paper_positions
LOG.description: Inserts: symbol, qty, avg_cost, price_target, stop_loss, highest_price, agent_label, signal_id. Deducts from cash.
LOG.addReason: Persists trade. Position monitor and LearnerAgent read from this table.
